name: hud_ui_options_panel_music_enable_on_activate
description: HudUiOptionsPanel_MusicEnable::OnActivate toggles the music-enable check state, writes the CD-audio option, and starts or stops CD playback.
known_limits: tier S verification is deferred for the HUD options-panel source-file/table cluster.
functional_evidence: Current Binary Ninja decompilation for 0x40cc80 calls HudUiCheckToggleWidget::OnActivate, stores ZSND_CDAUDIO_DISABLED and calls zSndCd::Stop when checked is zero, otherwise stores ZSND_CDAUDIO_ENABLED and calls zSndCd::PlayTrackWithMode(2, 5).

Native smoke zhud_options_panel_music_enable_on_activate_smoke patches zSndCd::PlayTrackWithMode and zSndCd::Stop, verifies unchecked-to-checked activation writes CD audio 1 and calls PlayTrackWithMode(2, 5), then verifies checked-to-unchecked activation writes CD audio 0 and calls Stop.
